selection_reasoning: These 12 tasks form a coherent multi-hop structure. The mining tasks (jungle_wood, acacia_wood) provide wood resources that feed into crafting a bow (which requires sticks from planks from wood). The splash potion of invisibility is used strategically before combat with the slime (stealth approach). Finding tasks (hay_block, rabbit, birch_trapdoor) serve as navigation/exploration prerequisites that guide the player through the scene toward resource areas. Mining cobblestone_wall, gray_concrete, red_mushroom, and warped_wart_block are intermediate tasks placed along the path. The dependency chain creates meaningful multi-hop reasoning: gather wood → craft bow → use invisibility potion → combat slime, with exploration tasks unlocking access to different areas.

Jungle wood provides planks and sticks needed as crafting ingredients for the bow
Acacia wood provides additional sticks needed to craft the bow (requires 3 sticks)
Birch trapdoor marks entrance to the walled area containing cobblestone walls to mine
Cobblestone wall section leads to the gray concrete structure behind it
Gray concrete room contains passage to nether-themed area with warped wart blocks
Warped wart block area connects to mushroom growing zone where red mushrooms spawn
Bow is needed as the ranged weapon to effectively combat the slime from safe distance
Invisibility potion allows safe approach to slime arena without taking early damage
Red mushroom area is adjacent to the potion chest containing splash invisibility potion

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Hay block is at (0, 0, 15) relative to spawn — 15 blocks away, requiring intentional navigation south. Max distance 5 means player must walk ~10 blocks to get close enough. Facing tolerance 60° ensures player is looking at the hay bales.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Rabbit pen center is at (0, 1, 20) relative to spawn. Max distance 5 requires player to walk to the pen area (20 blocks from spawn). Facing tolerance 60° ensures player is looking toward the pen where rabbits wander.

Uses inventory_has because mining jungle_wood (all-bark block placed at x+12) drops itself as the jungle_wood item into inventory when mined with any tool. The scene places minecraft:jungle_wood blocks which drop as jungle_wood.
Uses inventory_has because mining acacia_wood (all-bark block placed at x+15) drops itself as the acacia_wood item into inventory when mined with any tool.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a bow at the crafting table places it into the player's inventory. Recipe: 3 sticks (from wood→planks→sticks) + 3 string (given at start). The crafted bow appears in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Birch trapdoor is at (-8, 2, 0) relative to spawn, marking the fortress entrance. Max distance 4 requires player to walk right up to the entrance (8 blocks from spawn). Facing tolerance 60° ensures player is looking at the trapdoor.
Uses inventory_has because mining cobblestone_wall with an iron pickaxe drops the cobblestone_wall item into inventory. The wall is at x-10 in the fortress corridor and requires a pickaxe to drop.
Uses inventory_has because mining gray_concrete with an iron pickaxe drops the gray_concrete item into inventory. The wall is at x-12 in the fortress corridor.

Uses inventory_has because mining warped_wart_block with the iron hoe (provided in revised scene) drops the warped_wart_block item into inventory. Critical: this block ONLY drops when mined with a hoe — pickaxe yields nothing. The wall is at x-14.
Uses inventory_has because breaking a red_mushroom drops the red_mushroom item into inventory. Red mushrooms break instantly with any tool or bare hand. Located at x-16 on mycelium.

Uses position_inside_box as a spatial proxy because no available rule type can directly detect splash potion throwing (usage removes it from inventory, making inventory_has fail AFTER use). The arena interior (x-21 to x-18) is only reachable by passing through the potion chest room at x-17 in the linear corridor. Box excludes the chest position to ensure player has moved beyond the pickup point into the arena, implying potion retrieval and progression.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because this is a combat/kill task. The Size:1 slime at (-20, 1, 0) splits into 2-4 Size:0 tiny slimes on death. Setting max_count=3 confirms the original slime was killed (combat completed) — a living Size:1 slime counts as 1, but after death it becomes 2-4 tiny slimes. If max splits (4) occur, player must kill at least 1 tiny slime to reach ≤3. Box generously covers the arena with padding to ensure slime stays inside detection area.

scene_description: A compact adventure arena with distinct zones arranged for sequential multi-hop task completion. Farm area (south, z+15) with hay bales and fenced rabbit pen. Wood grove (east, x+12 to x+15) with jungle_wood and acacia_wood trees plus crafting table. Linear fortress corridor (west, x-8 to x-21) with birch trapdoor entrance progressing through cobblestone walls, gray concrete, warped wart blocks, red mushroom cave, potion chest, and slime combat arena. Player receives iron pickaxe, iron hoe, string, and arrows — no melee weapon, making the crafted bow essential for combat.
task_text: Explore this adventure arena: Navigate south to find the hay block landmark and the rabbit pen. Head east to the wood grove to harvest jungle wood and acacia wood. Craft a bow at the crafting table using sticks from the wood and the string in your inventory. Then head west to find the birch trapdoor fortress entrance. Mine through the cobblestone wall, gray concrete, warped wart blocks (use your hoe!), and collect red mushrooms in the cave. Retrieve the splash potion of invisibility from the chest, use it, then enter the arena and combat the slime with your bow.
design_notes: Final consolidated version incorporating all multi-agent review fixes: (1) No melee weapon — bow is only combat option. (2) Iron hoe provided for warped wart block mining. (3) Slime is Size:1 for visibility (~1 block tall). (4) 32 arrows for bow combat including tiny slime remnants. (5) Hay block at z+15 prevents trivial milestone trigger at spawn. (6) Scene footprint: x-21 to x+16 (37 blocks E-W), z-3 to z+22 (25 blocks N-S). (7) Linear corridor: entrance x-8, cobblestone x-10, concrete x-12, warped x-14, mushroom x-16, chest x-17, arena x-18 to x-21. Each wall 1 block thick with full air rooms between for passage. (8) All blocks match their task names exactly (jungle_wood, acacia_wood, cobblestone_wall, gray_concrete, warped_wart_block, red_mushroom).
